title: October 24, 1945: the United Nations Charter took effect - and India had already signed it, two years before its own independence.

sources.text: Wikipedia - India and the United Nations
IANS - UN Charter symbolises hope for its 1.4 billion citizens: India

caption:
October 24, 1945: the United Nations Charter took effect - and India had already signed it, two years before its own independence.

India was a founding member of the United Nations, having signed the Charter at the San Francisco Conference in June 1945 - while still under British rule, more than two years before independence in August 1947.

India's UN membership traces back even further - to its signing of the 1942 Declaration by United Nations in Washington - giving the country an institutional seat at the global table years before it could set its own domestic policy.

Having a seat at the UN's founding gave India a permanent voice in global institutions from day one - a head start few other newly independent nations had.
